events.price_note: $20; free for students and financially challenged attendees
events.title: Hummingbird / We Micromanage Infinity
events.why: West Oakland's small new-music room gets a very particular live collision: modular synths, software, toy noisemakers, birdcalls, piano, reeds, and drums.

events.title: Do-Over Music Series: Weeks / Thingamajigs
events.why: The second set turns Shapeshifters' 16mm archive into live expanded cinema, pairing projected loops with improvised electronics, handmade apparatus, glass, sho, and guitar.

events.title: In Darkness and Secrecy: The Silent Singularity
events.why: A rare critical-tech evening rather than startup chatter: media theorist Bogna Konior traces AI, espionage, negative theology, and the Fermi Paradox, followed by a conversation.

events.price_note: $10 adults; $5 youth ages 8-17; ages 7 and under free
events.title: Paramount Theatre Public Tour
events.why: The public tour is a direct hit: 90 minutes inside Oakland's art-deco movie palace, with its history, craftsmanship, and spaces normally hidden by the curtain.

events.title: FF in SF: A Celebration of 50 Years of Free Expression with Franklin Furnace
events.why: A free, convivial hinge between artists' books and performance: Franklin Furnace's 50th gets a book talk, signing, archive-minded context, and a live set at The Lab.

events.title: Unsilent Night 2026
events.why: Bring a phone, boombox, or portable speaker and become one track in a four-channel walking sound sculpture across campus: an analog-tech public orchestra.

events.price_note: Pay what you want; $10 suggested donation; museum admission free; bring quarters
events.title: Cybersentics Book Club: Love Testers + Musée Mécanique Tour
events.why: The most direct Deliria2-adjacent choice: a hands-on look at pre-dating-app compatibility machines, plus a conversation about their algorithms, biases, and sensorium.
